newsitem.title: FINLAND: KESKO OFFERS TUKO TO SPONSOR - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: KESKO OFFERS TUKO TO SPONSOR - PAPER.

text.p: Finnish wholesaler and retailer Kesko has offered parts of its Tuko unit to holding company Sponsor Oy, owned by banking group Merita , daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Thursday.
It have no sources and nobody was available for comment at Kesko.
There have been negotiations on the selling of Tuko's daily goods operations for several weeks, with various buyer candidates but now the talks are on hold, Helsingin Sanomat quoted Kesko as saying.
Kesko announced last May it would acquire its rival Tuko, but the EU Comission blocked the merger in Novemebr saying it would damage competition in the daily goods market in Finland.
